Satellite name TY-5 (TY5)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 6U
Status cancelled
Organisation Spacety
Institution Company
Entity type Commercial
Country China
Manufacturer AIVT by Spacety
Oneliner

Test software defined radio technology.
Description

A camera to take photos for deep space. Micro actuator technology to adjust CMOS sensor so as to improve the stability of taking photos. This will provide opportunities for radio amateur to use their simple equipment to get beautiful deep space pictures. Synchrotron ionospheric transmission detection experiments based on multi-satellite and multi-band with the same GPS time base.

Carry out amateur HF/VHF/UHF retransmitting experiments in any narrow-band code. Carry out communications experiments between inter-satellite amateur loads, LIFI high-speed digital downlink and CW lamp signal communication experiments.
Notes

There was an earlier application for 2U TY2-TY5 CubeSats from Spacety. Time will tell.
